id: title:EDsCODE:default send raw query to on for the managed warehouse connection

observations.behavior: Adds conditional check to force raw SQL mode specifically when the selected connection has the managed warehouse prefix, while retaining HogQL support for other connections.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes query behavior in PostHog's frontend editor; users connecting via managed warehouse will now send queries as raw SQL rather than HogQL, potentially affecting compatibility or performance depending on backend implementation.

observations.behavior: Adds test assertions expecting that managed warehouse connections trigger raw SQL mode and retain HogQL support flag, while user-managed PostgreSQL direct connections do not force raw SQL mode.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection and expected behavior documentation for this change; no production benefit demonstrated without corresponding backend changes.

observations.behavior: Defines a constant string used to identify managed warehouse sources by their API response prefix, shared between backend and frontend implementations.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes naming convention and boundary marker between managed and self-hosted warehouse configurations; does not independently demonstrate broader capability improvement.
